name: Somekingi
overview: A comedy drama about long-term unemployed Teemu, whose video CV becomes a viral hit. Not because it's that good, but because it's mind-bogglingly bad. However, Teemu draws the wrong conclusions and decides to start a career as an influencer. Starring Elias Keränen, Joel Hirvonen, Linnea Leino and Vilma Sippola.
